images.title: Every place but the units is a multiple of 10
images.purpose: Shows 3716 split into 3000 + 700 + 10 + 6, where every part except the units digit is a multiple of 10, so only 6 decides divisibility by 2 and 5.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One number at the top splitting into four place value boxes in a row.
images.exact_structure: At the top, the number 3716 in large dark text. Four thin arrows lead down to a row of 4 rounded boxes: 3000, 700, 10 and 6. The first three boxes are filled light grey (#6B7280) and share one brace under them labelled multiples of 10. The fourth box, 6, has a thick reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline and the label units digit under it. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Only the units digit decides divisibility by 2 and by 5, because every other place is a multiple of 10.
images.description: Shows 3716 split into 3000 + 700 + 10 + 6, where every part except the units digit is a multiple of 10, so only 6 decides divisibility by 2 and 5.
images.context: 3716 = 3 × 1000 + 7 × 100 + 1 × 10 + 6; 6 is even, so divisible by 2 and not by 5.

image_decisions.why: The place value split shows why the shortcuts for 2 and 5 look only at the last digit.
